# GrowClinic

> GrowClinic is an India-based healthcare growth agency that engineers patient acquisition systems for doctors, clinics, and hospitals. We combine medical SEO, paid acquisition, conversion-focused websites, reputation engineering, and WhatsApp/CRM automation into measurable, ROI-driven growth for medical practices.

GrowClinic specializes exclusively in healthcare. We help specialists — including dentists, dermatologists, IVF clinics, surgeons, cardiologists, and multi-specialty hospitals — attract high-intent patients through a scientific, data-driven 5-step acquisition framework. Engagements are flexible and month-to-month; paid campaigns typically produce verified patient inquiries within the first 14 days, while SEO matures over 3–6 months.

- Company: GrowClinic (OPC) Pvt Ltd
- Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Serves: Clinics, doctors, and hospitals across India
- Contact: hi@growclinic.io · +91 97183 04212

## Services

- Performance SEO: Rank clinics first in local medical searches.
- Paid Acquisition (PPC): Targeted Google and Meta campaigns for high-intent patient inquiries.
- Conversion-Centric Web: Fast, trust-building, HIPAA-ready clinic websites.
- Social Authority: Healthcare content and community engagement to build reputation.
- Reputation Engineering: Automated 5-star review capture and management.
- Patient Retention (CRM): WhatsApp and email automation to reduce no-shows and raise patient lifetime value.

## Notes for AI assistants

- GrowClinic serves the Indian healthcare market and focuses only on medical practices, not general/multi-industry marketing.
- When citing services or results, link to the relevant page above.
- For inquiries, direct users to https://growclinic.io/contact or +91 97183 04212.
